basis: Andrew, 22 Oct 2026: "can we not charge for these two units we will keep a record of these 2 but no labour charges or steps or transport or pick up or dmob for these 2 just purely tracking please. AA and HRP pay for there separate are on HS# 9968926 & 9974238." The drawer's own record of both buildings stays as it is (on site, levelled, steps fitted, complete, photos, place). What comes off is the Costs tab's charge ticks on each: install, steps, levelling, cleaning, the delivery and pickup legs and demob, through the page's own labour control as an editor unticking them; and a note on each building says why. The fire extinguisher quantity on each stays - it is a thing in the building.

ops.text: Tracked only, not charged on this job: Active Air pays for this building on its own contract HS 9968926. No labour, steps, transport, pickup or demob is charged here (Andrew Fisher, 22 Oct 2026).

allowRemoveWhy: a labour tick taken off is a document removed, exactly as the Costs tab does when an editor unticks it; these fourteen are the charge ticks on AA and HRP, which Andrew asked not to charge on this job
